snippet.title: Mycocosm Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
MYCOCOSM is a casual arcade shooter and resource manager where you take the role of a newly sprouted seedling. Fight off waves of soil-borne enemies using antimicrobial chemicals, and trade for precious nutrients with wandering fungal spores - but beware their deceitful dealings. 

Wishlist on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075670/Mycocosm
